create.intro_md:
## Reaction Role Panel Setup

Click the button below to create a new reaction role panel.

**What is a panel?**
A panel is a message that users can react to in order to receive roles. You can set up two modes:
- **Post Embed** — the bot posts a new embed to a channel you choose.
- **Use Message ID** — the bot attaches reactions to an existing message.
